description: Add a season to a series (a film created with kind: series), numbered after the last one, as a draft. Title and synopsis are optional ("Season N" otherwise); a buy/rent price here sells the whole season once it is published with a playable episode. Up to 50 seasons. The age rating and content descriptors belong to the whole series (create_film / update_film), not to a season or episode. Returns the film (with every season) and the new season's id for add_episode.

buy_price.description: Buy price for the whole season in US cents (minimum 100); null removes it. Only sells once the season is published with a playable episode.

film_id.description: The film's public id (from list_films / get_film).

rent_price.description: Rental price for the whole season in US cents (minimum 100); null removes it.

rental_window_hours.description: How long a season rental lasts, in hours.

synopsis.description: The season's synopsis; null clears it.

title.description: The season's title (up to 200 characters); null clears it, leaving "Season N".

name: add_season
title: Add a season
